name: The Calculator
source:
In this short sci-fi visual novel, you assume the role of Betty, an English housewife who goes out looking for her missing husband. Can she find him? and, most importantly, what will she find once she finds him?

Source: https://www.indiedb.com/games/the-calculator
translation:
在这部短篇科幻视觉小说中，你将扮演英国主妇贝蒂，外出寻找失踪的丈夫。她能找到他吗？更重要的是，一旦找到他，等待她的又会是什么？

来源：https://www.indiedb.com/games/the-calculator
